purpose: Teach: デイトレード/圏内/屈指/約款/朗報/物的/司書/仕掛ける

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、不正デイトレードの捜査もご対応ですね
lines.en: So the police also investigate cases of illegal day trading.
lines.style: Conversational, mildly curious inflection. Steady rhythm. A gentle upward lilt at the end—genuinely learning something new about police work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、管轄圏内の犯罪に対応されますね
lines.en: The police handle crimes within your jurisdiction, then.
lines.style: Thoughtful nod in the voice. Moderate pace, factual but not clinical. A small confirmatory pause at the clause break, like connecting dots.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、当地区屈指の防犯協会と連携されますね
lines.en: I see—you work closely with the top crime prevention associations in this area.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Genuine appreciation in the tone. Slight emphasis on 'closely'—noting the partnership as something noteworthy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、保険約款の不正もご捜査ですね
lines.en: You investigate insurance fraud too, then.
lines.style: Easy, factual. No emphasis—just adding another item to the growing list. Conversational momentum, no pause.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、解決事件の朗報を市民にもご共有ですね
lines.en: And you share the good news about solved cases with the community.
lines.style: Warm approval in the voice. Slight brightness on 'good news'—genuine appreciation for transparency. Encouraging tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、物的証拠を厳格に保管されますね
lines.en: You keep physical evidence under strict security.
lines.style: Respectful emphasis on 'strict'. Firm, assured tone—noting the seriousness of evidence handling. No doubt in the delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、図書館の司書とも連携して市民教育されますね
lines.en: And you partner with library librarians for community education programs.
lines.style: Pleased recognition. Slight warmth—appreciating the unconventional partnership. A gentle upward lilt, like noticing something thoughtful.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、おとり捜査を仕掛ける場合もあるんですね
lines.en: So sometimes you run undercover operations to catch offenders.
lines.style: Slightly surprised, interested. A small lean-in quality in the voice. Measured pace—acknowledging the complexity of that work. Genuine respect.
